name: Cloze
task: Website or Shopify chat & FAQ deflection
summary: AI shopping assistant for Shopify: a chat widget wired to your live catalogue, inventory and knowledge base that answers product questions, compares items, tracks orders and hands off to a human. New listing: no reviews yet as of 19 Aug 2026.
best_for: Shopify stores with a catalogue big enough that shoppers ask which item to buy, who want a chat assistant that reads live inventory and hands off to a person, and who will watch the transcripts
skip_if: your support volume is low, or you want proof from other merchants before you put an AI in front of customers — there are no reviews yet
honest_knock: Two things to weigh, and the first is the price itself. On the same day, the App Store listing sold this at $49, $99 and $199 a month for 250, 750 and 2,000 conversations. The vendor's own site sold it at $29 and $79, with unlimited conversations on both paid tiers. The screenshot below is that page. Two prices and two different meters for one product is not a discount you can claim, it is an inconsistency to ask about before you pay. The second is the track record, or the absence of one. The app launched 24 April 2026 and, as of 4 September 2026, carries exactly one review — five stars, left after eight days of use. So there is next to no merchant experience to lean on, and the “Built for Shopify” badge is a technical bar, not a verdict on the answers. Also note what a conversation costs when it goes wrong. An assistant wired to live inventory and order tracking is answering with your data, and the free tier's 25 conversations a month is enough to test the tone but not enough to see it handle a bad day. The 3-day trial on paid plans is short for a support tool.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-08-19, re-verified unchanged 2026-09-04 on apps.shopify.com/cloze, listed as “Cloze: AI Shopping Assistant”) Free plan available: 25 AI conversations a month, up to 100 synced products, core assistant customisation and 7 days of conversation history. Paid tiers are Starter $49, Pro $99 and Scale $199 a month, each with $0.10 per additional AI conversation and a 3-day free trial. Starter covers 250 conversations a month and 1,000 synced products, with full customisation and 30 days of insights. Pro covers 750 conversations and 10,000 products with advanced insights and 90 days of history, and Scale 2,000 conversations, unlimited products, a year of history and priority support. All charges are billed in USD and recur every 30 days. Worth knowing before you install. The vendor's own site, cloze.bot/pricing, advertised a different and cheaper ladder on the same day: Free forever with 50 conversations a month, Pro $29 a month and Business $79 a month. On that page both paid tiers say unlimited conversations rather than a monthly allowance. Our link goes to the App Store listing, so the $49/$99/$199 ladder, with its caps of 250, 750 and 2,000 conversations, is what you pay when you install there. The screenshot further down is their own page exactly as we captured it. Developer Optify, Lyon, France; the app launched 24 April 2026, carries Shopify's “Built for Shopify” badge and had no reviews at all at the time of writing. Re-read on 4 September 2026: both ladders still stood exactly as described above, and the listing had gained its first review — a single five-star note left on 14 August 2026 by a French store eight days in.
